storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. Opened: refrigerate with the cap closed and use within about 2 to 3 months (general guidance; check the label).
looksLike: Thick, bright red sauce, often with flecks of chilli, sold in small glass or plastic bottles and pouches. Hot, sweet and sour.
howToPick: Check the manufacture date, an intact seal and a bright red colour without separation or mould at the neck. Check labels for onion/garlic powder (Jain) and wheat/malt vinegar (gluten).
shelfLife: Usually printed as about 9 to 12 months unopened (check the bottle); not taken from a source in this run.
substitutes: Red chilli paste plus a pinch of sugar and a few drops of vinegar
Fresh red chilli paste with a pinch of sugar and vinegar
